budget_items.what_was_said: A parent asked whether the district would stay with the state grant's seat count or add more seats funded from elsewhere in the budget, since prior spending plans approved by the committee had proposed larger seat counts.

A commenter noted the FY27 budget line covered high school and middle school athletic transportation combined, and questioned how the restoration figure could be so much lower and why it wasn't found during FY27 budget building.

budget_items.topic: School fund balances (school choice revolving, circuit breaker, gift fund, after-school activities)
budget_items.what_was_said: A commenter listed several school-controlled fund balances as of a recent date and suggested drawing modest amounts from each to help fund middle school sports restoration.

budget_items.topic: State aid request vs. school choice/charter assessment increase and receiving tuition
budget_items.what_was_said: A commenter said the requested state-aid figure does not account for an increase in school choice/charter sending tuition owed to the state, and that it includes a receiving-tuition amount that goes to the district automatically without town meeting appropriation.
A commenter said the schools received far less than needed to maintain FY26-level services and urged the town to focus on that larger shortfall rather than smaller disputed amounts.

budget_items.topic: Ignite tutoring seat cost and funds freed
budget_items.what_was_said: The superintendent said the district will keep the grant-funded seat count and not fund additional seats, which frees money from the original ask to redirect to other scenarios.

budget_items.topic: Scenario 1: independent financial audit + athletic transportation
budget_items.what_was_said: The superintendent proposed an RFP for an independent financial audit of the schools plus restoring athletic transportation, funded partly from new town-meeting money and partly from the athletic revolving account.

budget_items.topic: Athletic revolving account balance and spending
budget_items.what_was_said: The superintendent gave the verified balance of the athletic revolving account as of a mid-August date and the amount spent so far this year, to show it could help cover transportation.
The superintendent said a vendor gave an approximate transportation cost which she rounded up to allow for incidentals.

budget_items.topic: Scenario 2: grade 2 class size reduction + literacy PD
budget_items.what_was_said: The superintendent proposed using freed funds to add a second-grade teacher and extend literacy professional-development support to the middle and high school, plus the athletic transportation restoration.
The superintendent proposed hiring a second board-certified behavior analyst, priced higher than a teacher line due to certification level, alongside the athletic transportation restoration.
The superintendent said out-of-district placements are rising and gave rough average costs per placement including transportation and bus monitors, to justify the BCBA scenario.

budget_items.topic: Warrant article 3: citizens petition free-cash transfer for middle/high school sports
budget_items.what_was_said: The article as read proposes transferring a specific sum from certified free cash to the FY27 school operating budget to restore middle school sports and provide student-athlete transportation.

A committee member relayed that a lower figure would restore basketball and outdoor track for middle school (cross country and field hockey could not be scheduled), and a higher figure would add lacrosse and ski at the high school level.

budget_items.topic: Breakdown of middle school sports restoration figure
budget_items.what_was_said: A committee member itemized the components behind the middle-school restoration estimate: coaching stipends at the top CBA step, transportation, and officials/entry fees.

budget_items.topic: High school lacrosse and ski co-op costs
budget_items.what_was_said: The athletic director's figures for last year's ski co-op invoices and girls lacrosse transportation and coaching were cited as the basis for the additional high-school restoration amount.

budget_items.topic: Music boosters donation for middle school jazz band
budget_items.what_was_said: A commenter cited a small booster donation that restored a cut middle school jazz band item, offered as an example of cuts affecting many programs, not just athletics.

decisions.decision: The district will keep the grant-funded 36 Ignite tutoring seats and not fund additional seats from the general fund or further town-meeting appropriation.
The sponsor of warrant article 2 said he will move to pass over that article at town meeting regardless of whether article 1 passes or fails.

The committee will not spend school-controlled fund balances (school choice revolving, circuit breaker, after-school activities) on middle school sports restoration this year, pending better data from the new athletic director.
The committee will refund a donation it had accepted toward athletic transportation, returning it to the booster club that raised it.

minutes.summary: The Lunenburg School Committee heard extended public comment on staff turnover, reading scores, and school funding, then reviewed three alternative spending scenarios for additional state aid to be requested at a special town meeting: an independent financial audit, a second-grade teacher plus literacy support, or an additional behavior analyst, each paired with restoring high school athletic transportation. The committee voted to bring the scenario adding a second-grade teacher and literacy professional development to finance committee, discussed two town-meeting warrant articles (one on financial transparency to be passed over, one a citizens' petition to fund middle school sports restoration), and voted to support the spirit of the sports-funding petition if town meeting appropriates outside money, without committing the schools' own fund balances.
